boundary: The register preserves known negatives; it is not an exhaustive failure inventory or security assurance.

operational_negatives.failure: Combined startup Git probe timed out before returning evidence.
operational_negatives.recovery: Split read-only Git proofs into bounded probes.

operational_negatives.failure: Windows PowerShell rejected an unsupported JSON parsing parameter.
operational_negatives.recovery: Use parameter-free input parsing on PowerShell 5.1.

operational_negatives.failure: Windows Sandbox state was elevation-gated and its executable was absent.
operational_negatives.recovery: Fail closed without elevation or host change.

operational_negatives.failure: Fourteen first-draft cleanup titles collided exactly with predecessor titles.
operational_negatives.recovery: Redesign purpose, artifact, and acceptance surfaces; exact collisions became zero.

operational_negatives.failure: The selected runtime had no pytest module and ran zero tests.
operational_negatives.recovery: Use the dependency-free direct scoped-test entrypoint without installing anything.

operational_negatives.failure: Phase-local family-index output showed CRLF and a rendering defect.
operational_negatives.recovery: Normalize only the owner output to UTF-8 LF and recheck semantics.

operational_negatives.failure: A shell-sensitive upstream shorthand became an ambiguous revision.
operational_negatives.recovery: Use explicit quoted remote refs; the equality proof then passed.

operational_negatives.failure: A cold aggregate repository inspection exceeded a ten-second wrapper budget.
operational_negatives.recovery: Separate status and source reads with realistic bounded limits.

operational_negatives.failure: A multi-file raw-content read exceeded its aggregate output budget.
operational_negatives.recovery: Read one complete file or compact symbol surface at a time.

operational_negatives.failure: A guessed Method Flow summary filename did not exist.
operational_negatives.recovery: List exact phase filenames before selecting the frozen artifact.

operational_negatives.failure: A guessed cleanup portfolio filename did not exist.
operational_negatives.recovery: Enumerate maintenance files and load the observed clean-refine plan.

operational_negatives.failure: A verification probe guessed a novelty subdirectory that does not exist.
operational_negatives.recovery: Use the observed provenance collision-audit path.

operational_negatives.failure: Python received a literal wildcard during the first compile check.
operational_negatives.recovery: Expand matching files in PowerShell; every resolved module compiled.

operational_negatives.failure: The first core runner hit a Windows cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError while printing boundary text.
operational_negatives.recovery: Set UTF-8 subprocess I/O and rerun; repository artifacts remained UTF-8.

operational_negatives.failure: One portfolio consumer retained the stale guessed novelty path and rejected its acceptance.
operational_negatives.recovery: Update every owner consumer to the observed provenance audit path and rerun all portfolios.

operational_negatives.failure: The first scoped unittest wrapper lacked the repository root and returned eight import errors with zero test credit.
operational_negatives.recovery: Add the explicit repository root and rerun the unchanged v645-v3 through v645-v6 scope.

operational_negatives.failure: The first evidence builder reused two frozen x1 receipt paths.
operational_negatives.recovery: Restore both exact x1 files and use additive lifecycle-suffixed x2 receipts.

operational_negatives.failure: The first cached diff-hygiene review found an extra blank line at runtime.py EOF.
operational_negatives.recovery: Remove it and require a clean cached diff check before commit.

operational_negatives.failure: The first five-class staged scan found three self-matches in scanner source.
operational_negatives.recovery: Construct equivalent patterns from split fragments and rerun without reducing scan scope.
